lastPrompt:
Generate a high-fidelity UI mockup of a professional landing page website for "MLOps Automation Platform". The design must be a full-page screenshot-style mockup, realistic web design, not a 3D render or illustration. Dark monochromatic color scheme.

LAYOUT (top to bottom):

1. NAVIGATION BAR at top: Logo text "MLOps Platform" on left, nav links "Características", "Pipeline", "Tech Stack", "Docs" on right. Background #09090b.

2. HERO SECTION (large, centered):
   - Large bold title text: "Automatiza tus Pipelines de Machine Learning, del Notebook a Producción"
   - Subtitle below in gray #a1a1aa: "Plataforma end-to-end que ejecuta, valida, registra y despliega tus modelos automáticamente cuando haces push a GitHub"
   - Two buttons side by side: Left button "Comenzar Ahora" with white #fafafa background and dark text, Right button "Ver Documentación" with transparent background and white border outline
   - Background gradient from black #09090b to dark charcoal #18181b

3. PIPELINE FLOW SECTION:
   - Horizontal diagram showing 5 connected phases with thin gray connecting lines between them
   - Each phase is a circle with minimalist icon inside: "Push" → "Descarga" → "Validación" → "Ejecución" → "Registro" → "Deploy"
   - Circles have light gray #a1a1aa borders, the active phase (Ejecución) glows bright white, others are medium gray #52525b
   - Labels below each circle
   - Dark background #18181b

4. FEATURES SECTION (3 cards in a row):
   - Card 1: "Integración con GitHub" - subtitle "Webhook automático al hacer push"
   - Card 2: "Monitoreo en Tiempo Real" - subtitle "Logs en vivo via WebSocket"
   - Card 3: "Auto-Deploy Inteligente" - subtitle "Deploy automático si accuracy >= 0.70"
   - Cards have dark background #1c1c1e, thin border #2a2a2e, subtle shadow, rounded corners, glassmorphism effect with slight transparency and blur
   - Each card has a minimal white icon at top

5. TECH STACK SECTION:
   - Row of technology logos/icons in grayscale: FastAPI, React, MLflow, Redis, Docker, Celery
   - On black #09090b background
   - Icons in gray with subtle styling

6. FOOTER: Minimal dark footer with copyright text "© 2026 MLOps Platform" and links, on #09090b background

STYLE: Monochromatic palette only - black #09090b, charcoal #18181b, dark gray #27272a, medium gray #52525b, light gray #a1a1aa, white #fafafa. No saturated colors at all. Sans-serif modern typography (Inter or similar). Generous spacing, clean minimal design. Premium corporate aesthetic. High resolution 4K mockup.
